ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Social Services Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of social services fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and other cases.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the connections between entities
questions: What is the total amount of money lost to social services fraud in Minnesota?
How many people are involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and tracking connections between entities, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify patterns and trends.
